## File: facebookresearch_reagent/reagent/scripts/hparam_tuning.py

Prompts

```
['run a Bayesian hyperparameter optimization search using Ax with parallel evaluation across multiple seeds', 'evaluate a list of hyperparameter configurations in parallel and return average metrics with standard deviation', 'run an Ax hyperparameter search with parameter constraints and save results to a JSON file', 'run an Ax hyperparameter search using a custom parse_params_fn to transform parameters before evaluation', 'run an Ax hyperparameter search that minimizes a specified objective metric over multiple steps']
```

Usage

```
{'run_ax_hyperparameter_search': 'run a Bayesian hyperparameter optimization search using Ax with parallel evaluation across multiple seeds', 'evaluate_hyperparameter_configs': 'evaluate a list of hyperparameter configurations in parallel and return average metrics with standard deviation', 'run_ax_search_with_constraints': 'run an Ax hyperparameter search with parameter constraints and save results to a JSON file', 'run_ax_search_with_custom_parser': 'run an Ax hyperparameter search using a custom parse_params_fn to transform parameters before evaluation', 'run_ax_search_minimize_objective': 'run an Ax hyperparameter search that minimizes a specified objective metric over multiple steps'}
```

function.name: run_ax_search
function.description: Run a search for best hyperparameter values using Ax.

ax_params.description: Ax configuration for hyperparameters that are searched over. See docs for ax_client.create_experiment()

eval_fn.description: Evaluation function that returns a dictionary of metric values.

obj_name.description: Objective name (key of the dict returned by eval_fn)

minimize.description: If True, objective is minimized, if False it's maximized.

id_.description: An arbitrary string identifier of the search (used as part of filename where results are saved)

parse_params_fn.description: A function applied to the parameter dictionary to parse it. Can be used

ax_param_constraints.description: Constraints for the parameters that are searched over.

num_ax_steps.description: The number of ax steps to take.

num_concur_samples.description: Number of configurations to sample per ax step (in parallel)

num_seeds.description: Number of seeds to average over

num_proc.description: Number of processes to run in parallel.

folder_name.description: Folder where to save best found parameters

verbose.description: If True, some details are printed out
